verdict.rationale: An interactive API reference is a fair thing to ask of a vector database, so the axis applies. The pack shows only static quickstart code snippets and mentions that Milvus Lite can run in Jupyter, which is a host environment and not an interactive reference. The OpenAPI probe found no spec at any candidate path, and nothing documents a try-it-out or runnable API explorer.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
